faq.q: How do I download a TikTok video without watermark?
faq.a: Open TikTok, tap Share on any video, then Copy Link. Paste the link above and click Download. Choose "HD · No Watermark" to save a clean video without the TikTok logo burned in.

faq.q: Is TokDown free to use?
faq.a: Yes. There is no registration, no account and no premium plan. The site is paid for by ads. When the upstream TikTok service is busy you may be asked to retry in a few minutes.

faq.q: Can I download TikTok audio as MP3?
faq.a: Yes. After fetching the video you will see an "Audio MP3" button to save only the sound track. Useful for TikTok sounds, background music, and voiceovers.

faq.q: Does it work on iPhone and Android?
faq.a: Yes. TokDown is a web app — open it in Safari (iPhone), Chrome (Android), or any modern browser. No app install needed.

faq.q: How do I save a TikTok video to my iPhone camera roll?
faq.a: After downloading, the video saves to your Files app. Open Files, find the video, tap Share, then "Save Video" to move it to your Camera Roll.

faq.q: How do I save a TikTok video on Android?
faq.a: Tap the download button and the video saves directly to your Downloads folder. Open it in your Gallery app from there.

faq.q: Why can't I download a private TikTok video?
faq.a: Private videos require login authentication that we cannot access. Only public TikTok videos are downloadable. If the video is public and still failing, the creator may have disabled downloads in their settings.

faq.q: What video quality is available?
faq.a: We offer HD (the highest resolution the creator uploaded) and SD versions, both without the watermark. HD is recommended for sharing or editing.

faq.q: What formats does TokDown support?
faq.a: Videos download as MP4 (HD or SD, no watermark). Audio downloads as MP3. MP4 plays on all devices; MP3 works in any music app.

faq.q: Is it safe to use TokDown?
faq.a: Yes. TokDown never asks for your TikTok credentials and does not store any video files. The video is streamed through our server straight to your device and is never saved along the way.

faq.q: Why does TikTok add a watermark in the first place?
faq.a: TikTok embeds a watermark on videos saved through their native app to encourage sharing back on the platform and to brand the content. TokDown fetches the original source file before the watermark is applied, so what you get is the clean version.

faq.q: Can I download TikTok slideshows or photo posts?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the link of a photo post or slideshow into the TikTok photo downloader (tokdown.org/photo-downloader) and save every image in full size, one by one or all at once, plus the sound as MP3.

faq.q: Is it safe to download TikTok videos?
faq.a: Yes. TokDown never asks for your TikTok login and never stores videos on its servers. The file is fetched from TikTok's CDN and streamed to your device in a single pass — nothing is kept. We have no access to your TikTok account.

faq.q: How do I download TikTok without installing an app?
faq.a: Open tokdown.org in any browser on your phone or computer — Safari, Chrome, Firefox, or Edge. No app download or installation is required. Just paste the link and download.

faq.q: Can I download TikTok videos on a PC or laptop?
faq.a: Yes. Open tokdown.org in Chrome, Edge, or Firefox on Windows or Mac. Paste the TikTok link and click Download. The video saves to your Downloads folder as an MP4 file.

faq.q: Why is my downloaded TikTok video blurry?
faq.a: You most likely selected the SD option instead of HD. Go back and choose "HD · No Watermark" for the sharpest quality. Also make sure your internet connection was stable during the download — a slow connection can cause incomplete downloads.

faq.q: How long does a TikTok download take?
faq.a: Most downloads complete in 5–15 seconds. Longer videos (3–10 minutes) or slower internet connections may take up to 30 seconds. There are no queues or waiting times.

faq.q: Is downloading TikTok videos legal?
faq.a: It depends on your country and on what you do with the file. Many countries allow a private copy for personal viewing, but TikTok's terms restrict downloading outside its own features, and re-uploading, redistributing or monetising someone else's video without permission is copyright infringement almost everywhere. Use TokDown for personal use and for your own content.

faq.q: Can I download TikTok Live streams?
faq.a: No. TikTok Live streams are broadcast in real time and are not stored as downloadable video files. Only recorded (non-live) public TikTok videos can be downloaded with TokDown.

faq.q: Does TokDown work without a TikTok account?
faq.a: Yes. TokDown only works with publicly available TikTok videos and does not require any TikTok account — yours or anyone else's. Simply paste the public video link and download.

About.metaTitle: About TokDown – Who Makes This Downloader
About.metaDescription: How TokDown works: where downloads come from, what is never stored, how ads pay for the site and how to reach us. Free tools, no account needed.
About.subtitle: TokDown is a small set of free download and media tools. This page explains how it works, what it does not do, and how it is paid for.
About.story1: Most "free" TikTok downloaders have the same playbook: bury the real download button under three fake ones, redirect you through ad domains, make you solve captchas, and — some of them — even ask for your TikTok username and password. We think that is unacceptable.
About.story2: TokDown was built to be the tool we wished existed: fast, clean, and honest. You paste a link. You get your video. That's it.
About.story3: We do not store any video files on our servers. When you hit download, the file is streamed from TikTok's CDN through our server to your device without ever being saved. We keep no record of what you downloaded; standard server logs are deleted automatically after 30 days.
About.how1: When you paste a link, TokDown detects the platform and asks a public source for the media: for TikTok a third-party API (TikWM), with TikTok's public video page as a fallback; for X the public data used for embedded tweets; for Facebook the public video embed. You get the file the platform serves, without re-encoding.
About.how2: The "no watermark" version is the original file as uploaded by the creator before TikTok's app overlays the logo. Both versions exist on TikTok's CDN; TokDown simply surfaces the right one.
About.how3: The file is streamed through our server to your device in a single pass, because platform CDNs refuse direct browser downloads; nothing is written to disk. The video compressor and the MP4 to GIF converter work differently: they run entirely in your browser and your file is never uploaded.
About.legal: TokDown is intended for personal, non-commercial use only. Always respect the rights of TikTok creators — downloading a video does not transfer copyright. Do not redistribute, re-upload, or monetise downloaded content without explicit permission from the original creator. TokDown is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to TikTok or ByteDance in any way.
About.contact: Questions, bug reports or a copyright notice? Write to support@tokdown.org. Copyright notices follow the process described on our DMCA page.

GuideNoWatermark.whyTitle: Why does TikTok add a watermark?
GuideNoWatermark.why1: When you save a video using TikTok's built-in "Save video" button, TikTok overlays a watermark — your username and the TikTok logo — before saving it to your camera roll. This is intentional: it drives people who see the video elsewhere back to TikTok.
GuideNoWatermark.why2: The original video file (without watermark) is still hosted on TikTok's CDN. TokDown fetches that original file directly, bypassing the watermark entirely. The process is the same technical mechanism that TikTok's own embedding feature uses.
GuideNoWatermark.legal: Saving a public TikTok for private viewing is tolerated in many countries (for example as a private copy), but TikTok's terms restrict downloading outside its own features, and the rules differ by country. What is clearly not allowed is redistributing, re-uploading or monetising downloaded videos without the creator's explicit permission. Always credit the original creator and respect their copyright.

details: GIF is a 30-year-old format with a 256-colour palette and no compression between frames, which is why naive converters produce huge, grainy files. TokDown runs a two-pass ffmpeg pipeline in your browser: the first pass analyses your clip and builds a custom palette, the second pass maps every frame to it with ordered dithering. The result keeps text readable and gradients smooth at a fraction of the size.

You control the three things that decide file size: the clip length (up to 15 seconds), the frame rate (10 to 24 fps) and the width (240 to 800 pixels). For chat apps, 480 px at 15 fps is a good default; for documentation or a README, 640 px at 12 fps looks crisp and stays small. Because everything runs locally, you can iterate as many times as you like without uploading anything.

sections.title: Do you need the TikTok app on your computer?
paragraphs: No. Many “download TikTok on PC” results explain how to install the TikTok app from the Microsoft Store, or how to run the Android app on a Mac through an emulator such as BlueStacks. Neither is needed to save a video: the TikTok website plays every public video in the browser, and its link is all a downloader needs.

TikTok’s own download option, where the creator allows it, gives you a file with the TikTok logo and the creator’s username burned in. A web downloader gives you the file as it was uploaded, which is why it looks cleaner when you edit or crop it.

sections.title: Windows or Mac: what changes
paragraphs: Only the shortcuts (Ctrl on Windows, Cmd on Mac) and where files go. The first time, Safari may ask whether to allow downloads from tokdown.org: click Allow. Chrome and Edge show finished files in a small downloads panel at the top right.

The MP4 uses H.264 video and AAC audio, which every current player and editor opens: Photos, Clipchamp and VLC on Windows, QuickTime and iMovie on Mac, and Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut on both. No conversion is needed.

troubleshoot.fix: The free service that fetches clean files has a daily limit. Wait a few minutes and try again; nothing is wrong with your computer.

faq.a: The device makes no difference. A private copy for your own use is usually fine depending on your country; reposting or using someone else’s video commercially without permission is not, and TikTok’s terms restrict outside download tools.

steps.title: Paste it into the photo downloader
steps.body: Open tokdown.org/photo-downloader, paste the link and tap Download Photos. The video downloader on the home page accepts photo links too.

steps.title: Save the slides
steps.body: Tap an image to save that slide, or Download all to save every slide in order, numbered so they stay sorted. Chrome asks once to allow multiple downloads: tap Allow.

steps.title: Save the sound or the video version
steps.body: Tap Audio MP3 for the music. If a “Slideshow as video” button appears, it gives you one MP4 with every slide and the sound.

GuideSlideshow.ctaText: Have a slideshow link? Paste it into the photo downloader.

sections.title: Photos, sound or video: which one do you need?
paragraphs: Pick the photos when you want to print, edit or share a single image: they are the original files, with no watermark and no extra compression. Pick the MP3 when you only want the music or voice-over. Pick the video version when you want the slideshow exactly as it plays on TikTok, for example to send it in a chat app.

The video version only appears when TikTok has rendered one for the post. If it is missing, rebuild it from the images and the MP3 in any editor such as CapCut, iMovie or Clipchamp: add the slides in order, add the audio, and give each slide two or three seconds.

sections.title: Why slideshows trip up other downloaders
paragraphs: A slideshow is a set of images plus one audio track that TikTok plays together. Downloaders built only for videos look for a video file, find none, and fail or return just the first image. TokDown reads the image list itself, which is also why the slides carry no watermark: TikTok burns its logo only into rendered videos.

tips.title: iPhone: save to Photos
tips.body: In Safari an image may open in a new tab or go to Files. Press and hold the image and choose Save to Photos to put it in your Camera Roll.

tips.title: Android: look in Downloads
tips.body: Images go to the Downloads folder and appear in Google Photos or your Gallery under Downloads after a moment.

tips.title: Keep the order
tips.body: Use Download all rather than saving slides one by one: the files are numbered in the order the creator set.

tips.title: Credit the creator
tips.body: If you share a slide with the creator’s permission, tag the original account. The images carry no watermark, so the credit is up to you.

troubleshoot.fix: Your browser blocked the extra downloads. Look for a blocked-download icon in the address bar, allow multiple downloads for tokdown.org and press Download all again.
TikTok did not provide a rendered video for this post. Save the images and the MP3 and combine them in an editor, as described above.
Some posts have no separate sound file available, or no sound at all. The images still download normally.
The account may be private, the post friends-only, or it was deleted. Only public posts can be fetched.

faq.q: Can you download a TikTok slideshow as a video?
faq.a: Yes, when TikTok provides a rendered version: TokDown then shows a “Slideshow as video” button that saves one MP4 with the music. Otherwise save the photos and the MP3 and combine them in a video editor.

faq.q: How do I download TikTok slideshow pictures without watermark?
faq.a: Every slide downloads as the original image file. TikTok adds its watermark only to rendered videos, so the images are clean.

faq.q: Can I save a TikTok slideshow with the sound?
faq.a: Yes. The sound is offered as a separate MP3 next to the images, and it is part of the video version when one is available.

faq.q: Does TikTok’s own Save button work for slideshows?
faq.a: Depending on the app version and the creator’s download setting, TikTok may let you save a photo or a video version with its logo. A downloader gives you every slide at once, without the logo.

faq.q: Does it work on PC and Mac?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the link in any browser and use Download all; the images land in your Downloads folder.

faq.q: Can I download slideshows from private accounts?
faq.a: No. Like every downloader, TokDown can only fetch public posts.

GuideNoSave.metaTitle: TikTok Save Video Option Missing? Why & Fixes
GuideNoSave.metaDescription: No Save video button on TikTok? Why it disappears (creator settings, private or under-16 accounts), how to turn it on for your videos and what else to do.
GuideNoSave.h1: No “Save Video” Option on TikTok? Here’s Why
GuideNoSave.subtitle: The Save video button disappears for a few specific reasons. Find yours, fix it on your own videos, and see your options for someone else’s.
GuideNoSave.answer: TikTok hides or greys out Save video when the creator has turned video downloads off, when the account is private, or when the creator is under 16, whose downloads are always off. For your own videos, switch it on in Settings and privacy → Privacy → Downloads. For someone else’s video, ask the creator or keep it in your Favorites.
GuideNoSave.stepsTitle: What to do when Save video is missing

steps.title: Find out why
steps.body: Open the creator’s profile. A lock icon or “This account is private” means a private account. If the profile is public and Save video is missing or greyed out, the creator has turned downloads off or is under 16.

steps.title: Your own video? Turn downloads on
steps.body: Go to Profile → menu (☰) → Settings and privacy → Privacy → Downloads and switch it on. It needs a public account and an age of 16 or over, and it applies to all your videos, past and future.

steps.title: Keep it in Favorites
steps.body: Tap the bookmark icon to add the video to the Favorites tab on your profile. It is not an offline copy, but it is always allowed and keeps the video with its creator.

steps.title: Ask the creator
steps.body: A comment or message asking for the file, or for permission to save it, is the cleanest route, and the only one if you want to reuse it. Keep the reply as proof of permission.

steps.title: A private copy of a public video
steps.body: A web downloader such as TokDown reads the same public file your browser plays, so it can fetch a public video even when the button is off. Whether that is fine depends on your country’s private-copy rules and TikTok’s terms, which restrict outside download tools. Keep such a copy to yourself, never repost it, and leave young creators’ videos alone.

GuideNoSave.ctaText: Saving a public video for yourself only? Paste its link.

sections.title: The reasons the button disappears
paragraphs: The creator turned downloads off. Every creator aged 16 or over decides whether other people may download their videos. When the setting is off, TikTok hides or greys out Save video for everyone else, on old and new posts alike.
The account is private. Private accounts cannot turn downloads on at all, so their videos never show the option, not even to approved followers.
The creator is under 16. TikTok switches downloads off for these accounts and does not let them turn it on. For 16- and 17-year-olds the setting starts off and can be switched on.
The problem is on your side. If Save video is missing on every video, including from large public accounts, update the TikTok app, restart it and check that you are logged in.

sections.title: Screen recording is not a loophole
paragraphs: Recording your screen works on any phone, but you also capture captions, buttons and notifications, and the quality drops to your screen’s resolution. It does not change the rules either: the same copyright and private-copy limits apply to a recording as to a download.

faq.q: Why can’t I save some TikTok videos?
faq.a: Because the creator has turned downloads off, the account is private, or the creator is under 16. In each case TikTok removes or greys out the Save video option for other users.

faq.q: How do I turn on downloads for my TikTok videos?
faq.a: Profile → menu (☰) → Settings and privacy → Privacy → Downloads. Your account must be public and you must be 16 or older; the setting applies to all your posts.

faq.q: Can I download a TikTok when the creator turned downloads off?
faq.a: Technically a web downloader can fetch any public video. The creator has signalled that they do not want copies passed around, so keep it strictly for private viewing, never repost it, and skip it entirely for young creators. TikTok’s terms also restrict outside download tools.

faq.q: Does turning off downloads delete copies people already saved?
faq.a: No. According to TikTok, copies saved while downloads were on stay on other people’s devices. Turning the setting off only stops new downloads.

faq.q: Can I save a video from a private account?
faq.a: No, not with TikTok’s button and not with any web tool. Ask the person to send you the file.

GuideDraft.metaTitle: How to Save a TikTok Draft to Your Camera Roll
GuideDraft.metaDescription: Save a TikTok draft to your camera roll or gallery without anyone seeing it: the Only me trick, the Save to device switch, and a backup before a new phone.
GuideDraft.h1: How to Save a TikTok Draft to Your Camera Roll
GuideDraft.subtitle: Drafts live only inside the TikTok app on your phone. Here is how to get one into your camera roll or gallery without anyone else seeing it.
GuideDraft.answer: Most app versions have no “export draft” button. The dependable way: open the draft, tap Next, set Who can watch to Only me, switch on Save to device, and post. Nobody else sees the post, and a copy lands in your camera roll. You can delete the private post afterwards; the saved copy stays. Menu names vary a little between app versions.
GuideDraft.stepsTitle: Step by step: save a draft without posting it publicly

steps.title: Open your drafts
steps.body: Go to your Profile and tap Drafts, the first tile in your video grid. Tap the draft you want to keep.

steps.title: Go to the post screen
steps.body: Tap Next. Do not change the video; you only use the post screen to export it.

steps.title: Set Who can watch to Only me
steps.body: Tap the visibility setting (“Everyone can view this post”) and choose Only me. The post will not show up for followers or on the For You page.

steps.title: Switch on Save to device
steps.body: Open More options and turn on Save to device. On some versions the switch sits directly on the post screen.

steps.title: Post, then check your gallery
steps.body: Tap Post. When the upload finishes, the video is in your Photos app or Gallery. Keep or delete the private post: deleting it does not delete the saved copy.

GuideDraft.ctaText: Want to save someone else’s public TikTok instead? Paste its link into the downloader.

sections.title: Why you should back up drafts
paragraphs: Drafts are stored on your phone inside the TikTok app, not in your TikTok account. Deleting the app, clearing its storage or switching to a new phone deletes them, and logging in again does not bring them back. If a draft matters, export it before any of those happen.

sections.title: Other ways, and their downsides
paragraphs: Screen recording keeps everything private and needs no posting, but the copy includes whatever is on screen and only reaches your screen’s resolution. Start the recording, play the draft full screen in the editor preview, and trim the start and end afterwards.

Some app versions offer a save option directly in the drafts screen or the editor. If you see one, use it: it is the quickest. It is not available on every version or in every region, which is why the Only me method above is the dependable one.

tips.title: Watermark-free copy
tips.body: The Save to device copy is made on your phone from your own edit, so it is usually without the TikTok logo. Saving the posted video later from its Share menu adds the logo and your username.

tips.title: Publishing later
tips.body: If you decide to publish the video after all, open the private post, tap ⋯ → Privacy settings and set it to Everyone instead of uploading the file again.

tips.title: Getting a new phone
tips.body: Export every draft you want to keep with the steps above, then move the files with iCloud Photos, Google Photos or a cable. TikTok has no draft transfer.

troubleshoot.problem: The Save to device switch is missing
troubleshoot.fix: Update TikTok. If it is still missing, post as Only me anyway, then open the post, tap Share or ⋯ and choose Save video; that copy may carry the watermark.

troubleshoot.problem: The video did not appear in my gallery
troubleshoot.fix: Check that TikTok may save to your photos. iPhone: Settings → TikTok → Photos. Android: Settings → Apps → TikTok → Permissions → Photos and videos.
No, and no other web tool can either. A draft never leaves your phone, and an Only me post is private, so neither has a public link to fetch.

faq.q: Can you save a TikTok draft without posting it?
faq.a: On most app versions there is no direct button. Screen recording works without posting; otherwise post it as Only me with Save to device on, which nobody else can see.

faq.q: Will my followers see an Only me post?
faq.a: No. An Only me post is visible to you alone. It does not appear in followers’ feeds or on the For You page.

faq.q: Do TikTok drafts transfer to a new phone?
faq.a: No. Drafts are stored on the device, not in your account, so export the ones you want to keep before you switch.

faq.q: Does deleting the private post delete the saved video?
faq.a: No. The copy in your camera roll or gallery is a separate file and stays when you delete the post.

faq.q: Are TikTok drafts saved in the cloud?
faq.a: No. They stay on the phone where you made them, which is why deleting the app removes them.
